Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to record the closing time of a gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification window as an xsd:time.

Avoid when

  • Avoid carrying the opening time here (that is gmeow:opensAt) and avoid more than one close time per window — it is functional; mint a separate window for a split schedule.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:closesAt once per gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification (functional) to an xsd:time, paired with gmeow:opensAt and gmeow:openingDay; projects to schema:closes.

Examples

  • ex:weekdayHours gmeow:closesAt "17:00:00"^^xsd:time.
